mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a tightening labor market, boosting economic growth expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth expectations diminish.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combined signal indicates a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 month-over-month, the combined signal indicates a strong labor market, boosting economic growth expectations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained increases in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2% quarter-over-quarter, the combined signal indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong economic growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth is above 2% QoQ.
